## v2.3.1 — 2026-04-06

This v2.3.1 release delivers important stability improvements to our CI/CD pipeline and minor documentation updates. A key fix addresses an issue in the release workflow where the Ollama service was not correctly initialized before model operations, which previously caused build failures. Additionally, documentation for the v2.3.0 release was updated, and the project's landing page received a visual refresh.

### 🔧 Improvements

- Updated the v2.3.0 release notes and refreshed the landing page hero badge for improved presentation.

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

- Fixed the CI release workflow to ensure `ollama serve` starts before attempting to pull models, resolving build failures during the release process.

### 🧹 Chores

- Updated the project version to v2.3.1.
